critical_code_review_comments: submit() lambda body is invoked inside withTimeoutOrNull; if block() itself catches CancellationException internally, the deadline will not actually cancel the task. Consider a doctrine note but the current defensive try/catch(Throwable) outside withTimeoutOrNull correctly re-throws CE by NOT catching it explicitly (kotlinx re-throws CE by design in Kotlin 1.6+, so this is fine).
inFlight.remove(name, job) uses the value-equality remove — correct, avoids race where a newly-submitted job's entry is stomped by a stale invokeOnCompletion. Good.

coalesced check reads existing.isActive without atomic guarantee against concurrent submitters; two callers arriving simultaneously with no in-flight job could both launch. For a P0.4 maintenance worker this is acceptable (duplicate runs are cheap; single-flight is best-effort), but if strict single-flight is required, use inFlight.compute { name, existing -> ... } to atomically publish the job under the key. Non-blocking. Not a P0.4 blocker.
